# WK13 · Ma trận ngưỡng · Duyệt ma trận này

Group **WK · Agent chăm sóc (Next.js)** · dialog · Next.js: **exists (design W2)** (`/admin/care/matrix`) · account `doctor`

## Purpose
Dialog or drawer of [WK9](WK9.md) · Ma trận ngưỡng: Duyệt ma trận này. Page: Care administration, tab 3: the depth and autonomy matrix: from which depth the agent asks a person, per signal, and what the agent may send by itself (how many unedited approvals before a message type reaches level L2).

## Agent and care context
- This is the clinical decision of the clinic: the numbers are shipped as defaults marked "Chờ bác sĩ duyệt". The agent runs on them meanwhile but they are not treated as approved. Saving returns the matrix to pending; approving needs a doctor-level permission.
- Rules that must always be a person (for example red flags) are shown disabled with "Luôn do người quyết định, không chỉnh được".

## Who may see it
- Account in this frame: `doctor` (a mock account of `mock/auth.ts`; the back end decides the real matrix, the menu is a convenience).
- Gate: `care.matrix` to read and edit; the approve button needs `care.approve`.
- Roles that can open the page: owner, manager, doctor (cs_staff and reception cannot open it).
- Menu entry: "Ma trận ngưỡng" in the section "Care agent", shown when the role holds any of `care.matrix`.

## Key actions
- (actions of the page; this state or dialog adds the controls its Layout lists)
- Edit thresholds, depth per signal, promotion counts per message type
- "Lưu ma trận", "Bỏ thay đổi"
- "Bác sĩ duyệt" (doctor, owner, manager) and the reset to pending

- Two areas: care administration under `/admin/care/*` (menu section "Care agent": skills and shifts, 24/24 on-call numbers, depth matrix, SLA and send window, alerts) and per-patient supervision under `/care/*` (handoff queue, timeline, return to agent, tell the agent).

- Bác sĩ duyệt
- Các ngưỡng hiện tại được xác nhận là quyết định của bác sĩ. Hãy chắc rằng đã lưu mọi chỉnh sửa trước khi duyệt.
- Duyệt
- Hủy

## Business rules
- Control state per patient: AUTO (the agent answers or acts by its autonomy level L0 to L2; staff supervise the timeline and approve drafts) → HANDOFF_ROUTING (the agent is silent towards the patient except one template holding message, summarises for the candidate, runs the routing loop) → STAFF (the agent does not react, sends no scheduled reminders; it observes and drafts suggestions that are not sent). Only a staff member returns a conversation to AUTO (PLAN-AI01-M section 5).
- The agent decides to hand over by itself (skill `handoff`): depth D1 administrative, D2 standard care, D3 mild expected symptom, D4 medical judgement, D5 red flag. Defaults: D1 answers from L1, D2 answers from L2 with a source, D3 draft plus approval, D4 always calls a person, D5 calls a doctor at once without calling the model. The matrix that holds these numbers is configuration and carries "Chờ bác sĩ duyệt" until a doctor approves it (section 6).
- The candidate chain is 3 to 5 people and its last element is always the 24/24 on-call Zalo number, kept in the database, never in code. Default SLA: urgent 5 minutes, normal 30 minutes, outside working hours until the start of the next shift (section 7).
